Body: I am working on improving the structure of an older application.
That sounds familiar. Are you separating the business logic from the controllers?
Yes, that is the goal. It has made the code easier to follow already.
I am learning more about automated testing this week.
Congratulations! Those small wins really do add up.
I usually separate the application into layers and keep dependencies pointing inward.
Do you put DTO mapping in the controllers or in separate mapper classes?
I prefer separate mapper classes once the mapping gets more involved.
I would start with the business rules because they tend to contain the most important behaviour.
Agreed. Then I would add tests for invalid input and boundary conditions.
Try the forests around Silkeborg. There are several lovely routes.
Thanks! I will look those up.
Native plants provide food and shelter for insects and other wildlife.
I wish I had understood dependency injection earlier. It makes testing much easier.
I recently listened to a great podcast about software design. Happy to share the name if anyone is interested.
